captions.comparison_baseline_vs_proposed.png: Local person-detection operating points and published COCO references in separate non-comparable panels. Accuracy uncertainty is a 95% Student t interval: prior fixed-holdout models n=5, new matched six-epoch arms n=3. All prior-model FPS is N/A: original list-loader timings were invalid; corrected historical retimings are technically batch1 but unstable across runtime cohorts (identical checkpoint18.973versus32.142ms). Current FPS requires corrected loader/network batch1 proof and is descriptive of this session, without a speedup claim. Zero-finetuning diagnostics marked double dagger are n=1 without seed SD/CI; native80 predictions are person-filtered. Fix+tune combines restoration and recipe. Published FPS is source-reported or dagger-marked reciprocal reported latency; differing dataset/classes/hardware/backend/dtype/timing scope prevent direct comparisons. Validation-only diagnostics excluded.
captions.tradeoff_map_vs_latency.png: Corrected local accuracy–latency at416px, FP32, verified actual batch1 onRTX5060. Primary comparison comprises matched six-epoch control/proposed groups, n=3 with95% Student t intervals. Secondary zero-finetuning test diagnostics are n=1 without seed SD/CI; native80 predictions are person-filtered. All historical-model timing points omitted: original list-loader timings invalid, corrected historical cohorts unstable (samecheckpoint18.973versus32.142ms). No speedup claim; latency is descriptive of this runtime session and excludes loading/decoding/I/O. FPS is reciprocal median pipeline latency. Restoration+tuning does not isolate architecture effects. Logarithmic latency axis and illustrative33.3ms guide do not establish real-time readiness.
